text.en: This Act may be cited as the Petroleum (Pipe-lines) Short title Act. tion includes a corporation, whether aggregate or sole; means petroleum as defined in the cap. 44 Petroleum Mining Act; "pipe" and "pipe-line" mean a pipe or pipe-line used or intended to be used for conveying petor the products of petroleum in bulk from a of main storage to a point of distribution or a point of export from Brunei; road" means any highway by land whether or wheeled traffic which is mainout of public funds or is open to public use.

( 1) It shall not be lawful for any person to use or to to on any land in Brunei (whether such land is lay pipe-lines or is not the property of any such person) any pipes without permission first had and obtained.

(2) Every person desirous of obtaining permission to use or to lay and connect any such pipe-line shall apply in writing to the Minister for leave to do so.

(3) Such application shall be accompanied by a plan of the lands showing, as nearly as may be, the names of the B.L.R.O. 111984 owners and occupiers thereof, and also the course and direction of the pipe-line and the position of any pumping or other works in connection with such pipeline.

(4) His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council may thereupon, and upon such terms and conditions as he may think fit, grant permission to such petitioner(a) to use any pipe-line;

(b) to lay and connect any pipe-line over such as may be the property of the petitioner or over which he may have obtained way leave, and as to such lands, if any, as are not his property or over which he has not obtained way leave, to proceed under section 6.

heading.en: -8. Procedure when owner is under a disability

text.en: Any such owner after receipt of such notice and state-Assent to ment of particulars may assent to the laying down of such proposal pipe-lines upon payment of such compensation as may be agreed upon, and any assent so given shall be binding on all parties having any estate or interest in the land.

When the owner of the land is a minor or is mentally or is unable to read and write or suffers under any other disability or incapacity, both parties shall appear before the Minister who shall keep a record of all such agreements, and no such agreement shall become operative till it has been certified by the Minister to be fair and reasonable.

(1) An owner shall be deemed to have assented to the proposal to lay pipe-lines on his land if he fails to express his dissent therefrom within 3 months after the service of the notice on him under section 6.

(2) In the event of such dissent there shall be decided by the Minister on the application of the person desiring to lay pipe-lines, unless the parties mutually agree to accept arbitration, the questions following, that is to say -

(i) whether the proposed pipe-lines will cause any injury to such owner, or to the occupier or other person interested in the lands; and

(ii) whether any injury that may be caused is or is not of a nature to admit of being fully compensated for by money. _,

(3) The result of any such decision shall be as folis to say

(a) if the decision is that no injury will be caused to the owner, occupier or other parties interested in the lands, the person giving notice may proceed forthwith to lay the pipe-line;

heading.en: Owners of pipe-line may be declared to be common
